host_telemetry.hostname_policy: Repository-facing hostnames use the logical roles car and d1.
host_telemetry.process_policy: Host and process resource counters are retained; process command lines are omitted.

text_artifacts.policy: Deployment-specific endpoint addresses, hostnames, absolute paths, private IP addresses, and MAC addresses are replaced with logical placeholders.

edge_verification.policy: The remote-to-unredacted-local checksum comparison completed before redaction. Sanitized text files are not expected to retain their raw hashes.

location.policy: Only the approved 0.001-degree coordinate derivative and non-sensitive stationarity summary are repository-facing.

raw_recovery: The original files and one-minute GPS evidence remain recoverable from the locally excluded, checksum-manifested unredacted run tree.
